title: Bounded Context Map
description: GAP-020 — required artifact of gate-f2 (Design Baseline Approved), which until now declared no schema. Records the bounded contexts a design divides the problem into and, crucially, the RELATIONSHIP between each pair: a map that lists contexts without naming how they relate is an inventory, and the integration risk lives in the relationships.

contexts.description: The bounded contexts. At least one, because a design with no context boundary has not been divided.

responsibility.description: What this context is accountable for, in one sentence. A context that needs a paragraph is probably two.

ubiquitousLanguage.description: Terms whose meaning is local to this context — the words that mean something different next door.

owner.description: Team or role accountable for it.

relationships.description: How each pair of contexts relates. The patterns are Evans's, kept verbatim rather than renamed: a shared vocabulary with the literature is the point of using it.

rationale.description: Why this pattern and not another. `conformist` and `separate-ways` especially: both are decisions to accept a cost, and an unexplained one reads as an accident.

diagramRef.description: Path or URL to the rendered map. The structured contexts above are authoritative; the diagram is for humans.
